title: Yule-Walker AR Estimator
text: Compute estimate of autoregressive (AR) model parameters using Yule-Walker method, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Output(s)} sets Output of; {Inherit estimation order from input dimensions} and {Estimation order} sets the order of AR model. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: A
ports.summary: Normalized estimate of the AR model polynomial coefficients vector | matrix

ports.name: K
ports.summary: Reflection coefficients column vector | unoriented vector | matrix

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Square of model gain scalar | vector

params.name: Output(s)
params.values: Output of AR model coefficients A (default) | A and K | K

params.name: Inherit estimation order from input dimensions
params.values: Inherit estimation order from input dimensions on (default) | off

params.name: Estimation order
params.values: Order of AR model 4 (default) | nonnegative integer
